title: Verify: Action and choice update the story unit tests
summary: Unit tests for action and dialogue choice updating story
description: Add tests in tests/appFlow.test.tsx for Search and dialogue choice flows with mocked storage.
acceptance_criteria: Given Bookshelf menu, when Search clicked, then Story history list has the hidden door text
Given opening dialogue, when Look around the room clicked, then region Dialogue is gone and history has the text
technical_constraints: Reuse the storage mock from V1's file

steps.symbol: it('Search adds the hidden door text to the story history')
steps.action: Call begin(); click 'Bookshelf' then 'Search'; assert getByRole('list',{name:'Story history'}) toHaveTextContent('A hidden door swings open behind the books.').
steps.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/appFlow.test.tsx -t 'story'

steps.symbol: it('choosing a dialogue option closes the dialogue and records it')
steps.action: Call begin(); assert region 'Dialogue' exists; click button 'Look around the room'; assert queryByRole('region',{name:'Dialogue'}) is null and the Story history list toHaveTextContent('Look around the room').
steps.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/appFlow.test.tsx -t 'story'
